== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Lutoch Terelle, also known as Lutoch, is a professional information analyst who has spent a decade processing vast amounts of galactic data. Officially serving as the Chief Predictive Data Analyst for the [[Galactic Union]], her primary responsibility involves organizing intelligence and feeding it into the [[Zenith Processor]]. She is also referred to as the Oracle of Solstice{{!}}Oracle of the Solstice. In her work, she utilizes a sensory deprivation [[tank]] to manage information flow and connect with a sophisticated [[Aethertech]] processor that she inherited alongside her position. While she is capable of sorting through complex webs of data to help the galaxy progress, she lacks the ability to perceive the complete big picture that the [[Zenith Processor]] can. During her service with [[Union Intelligence]], she has worked alongside figures such as Kerathin{{!}}Archmage Kerathin.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a member of [[Union Intelligence]], Lutoch Terelle emerged from a sensory deprivation [[tank]]. Serving as the Oracle of Solstice{{!}}Oracle of the Solstice, Terelle held the responsibility of sorting through data to feed into the [[Zenith Processor]].
